detail.longDescription: Newsletters shouldn't spy on you. At virebent.art, we run listmonk on self-hosted infrastructure: zero tracking pixels, no telemetry, ALTCHA proof-of-work, and full privacy by design. We stand for digital sovereignty, open protocols, and verifiable publishing. Join us and take part in a surveillance-free digital commons: https:// newsletter.virebent.art # Privacy # Listmonk # SelfHosting # Fediverse # OpenSource
